ideas.title: Minnesota SNAP Food Stamp Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate a $1 million SNAP food stamp fraud scheme in Minnesota.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and identify key individuals involved
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a significant fraud scheme and potentially lead to further investigations and prosecutions.

ideas.title: Trump Administration's Medicare Enrollment Freeze
ideas.description: Investigate the Trump administration's freeze on Medicare enrollments for new home healthcare and hospice providers.
ideas.angle: Analyze the reasons behind the freeze and its impact on healthcare providers
questions: How will this affect healthcare providers?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on potential fraud in the healthcare sector and the administration's response to it.
